messages:
nina_csm: Heads-up 1:30 UTC1 - multiple onboarding jobs are stuck in 'processing' for >20m on embeddings.dedicated. Early triage shows request timeouts and retries. Impacting 12 accounts (2 enterprise, 4 SMB trials). Need customer comms + quick workaround.

leo_oncall: I'm on it. Root cause looks like scheduler backlog + network saturation on one Dedicated pool. Thundering herd from a large trial batch overloaded the pool's egress. Scaling action started; adding 2x nodes and limiting concurrent batches to 4. ETA ~8min.

sophie_eng: Adding that config change now: concurrent_batches=4, max_tokens_per_batch=512. Also enabling priority routing for enterprise contracts so their onboarding jobs jump queue.

carmen_am: Which accounts are enterprise? I need to ping their AMs and offer a manual assisted run.

nina_csm: Enterprise accounts: silverline-health, atlasfin. I'll draft a short message they can send.

nina_csm: Draft (AM copy):

```
Hi <Account Team>,

Were investigating delays affecting onboarding embeddings jobs since 13:30 UTC. Our engineers have applied temporary throttles and scaled the Dedicated pool to reduce failures.

What we can do for you now:
- Offer a manual assisted re-run on Dedicated (priority)
- Option to temporarily route your jobs to our hosted fallback (lower latency risk)

We expect normal processing to resume within 15-30 minutes. We'll send a full incident summary within 72 hours. Reply here if you'd like us to run the assisted job.

Thanks for bearing with us,
Redwood Inference CSMs
```

mark_sales_ops: Suggest offering a one-time onboarding acceleration (no charge) for the affected enterprise accounts and a 5% credit for trials impacted. Approve?

sophie_eng: Approve the workaround text. Approve the routing option but note hosted fallback uses a smaller model variant; potential quality delta.

leo_oncall: Pool scaled, concurrent_batches applied. Backlog processing resumed, error/retry rate falling. Monitoring.

incident_bot: [status] dedicated-scheduler: scale_up completed, queue depth decreased from 420 -> 32.

carmen_am: I'll DM the enterprise AMs with the copy + offer to run the assisted re-run. Will flag AtlasFin for priority routing today.

nina_csm: I'll send the shorter public notice to the 12 affected customers in ~10m after we confirm stability. Plan for RCA: initial blameless summary + timeline within 72h, full root cause + long-term mitigations within 5 business days.

mark_sales_ops: Approved. I'll coordinate the credits with finance after Carmen confirms impacted trial list.

leo_oncall: Monitoring now for 30m. If stable we'll mark mitigated and prep the incident ticket for the RCA.

nina_csm: Thanks team 91d. I'll attach this thread's notes to the customer outreach ticket and capture any responses for the RCA.
